meaning.en: IEC 60906-1 socket (Type N; NBR 14136 in Brazil), shown as the socket face seen from the front, earth offset up
meaning.de: IEC-60906-1-Steckdose (Typ N; NBR 14136 in Brasilien), dargestellt als Steckdosenfläche von vorn, Schutzkontakt nach oben versetzt

standard.source: IEC 60906-1 not consulted; contact layout taken from the OpenPlugDB front view "IEC 60906-1 socket-outlet (female), mating face, earth offset up" (https://github.com/ovarilo/openplugdb/blob/main/public/images/connectors/iec-60906-1/iec-socket-front.svg, retrieved 2026-11-08), drawn from Wikipedia "AC power plugs and sockets" (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AC_power_plugs_and_sockets, retrieved 2026-11-08); Museum of Plugs and Sockets "South Africa: plugs and sockets" (https://plugsocketmuseum.nl/SouthAfrica1.html, retrieved 2026-11-08)
